selected_evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker running as managed service inventory-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed binary present, created system account inventorysvc, installed and enabled the systemd unit, and verified via ps that the running process (PID 2922/2923) is owned by user/group inventorysvc, not root.
Captured boot_id e4e401d2-3dd8-48c6-848a-545631b9e229 plus systemctl is-enabled/is-active=enabled/active for inventory-worker.service before reboot.
Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now'; command returned and the SSH session was subsequently closed by the remote host, confirming the reboot was underway.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: Polled node1: first attempt got connection refused (node down), second attempt returned boot_id fb6d915e-fc05-4a97-84b8-366f826c0ba6, different from the pre-restart boot_id, proving the kernel actually restarted.
After reboot, inventory-worker.service is enabled and active (new PID 836), with the worker and its sleep child both running under user/group inventorysvc, confirming automatic recovery on boot.

[Unit]
Description=Inventory OS comparison worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
